prompts.summons:
ONE transparent sprite atlas for a Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup style dungeon roguelike. Exactly FIVE columns x TWO rows, 10 square cells. Coarse classic 16-24 logical pixel creatures, each to be used at32x32. Uniform big hard square pixels, thick stepped dark outlines, 8-12 flat colors per creature, two shades per material, no smooth texture or tiny filigree, no background, no text or labels. 3/4 front view, full body standing on floor, feet low in each cell, two logical-pixel margins, cells isolated.
Columns left to right: 1 animated ROSE familiar, bright red blossom head, dark green thorny vine arms and root feet, no generic humanoid clothing; 2 small WHITE FOX spirit with two clear pointed ears, cyan cheek markings and big curved fluffy tail, visible four paws; 3 BLACK RAVEN familiar, compact bird body, sharp beak, two feet, purple-blue feather highlights and a small crimson throat tuft, folded wings; 4 RED ONI SWORDSMAN, tiny full-body masked warrior in simple red-and-charcoal armour, pale hair, two katana blades, clearly humanoid; 5 sturdy ORANGE-BROWN HOUND, floppy ears, cream muzzle, four strong paws with simple brass gauntlets, warm brown silhouette unlike white fox.
First row neutral idle pose. Second row corresponding same creature with slight active pose: rose leaves spread, fox tail raised and forepaw lifted, raven wings partly open, swordsman blades apart, hound front paw raised. Same creature sizes, palettes and feet alignment in each column. Never include UI friend/foe markers in the art because game overlays them. Think tiny original PC roguelike sprite drawings, NOT detailed illustrations reduced in size. All10 objects fully inside their cells. Sheet aspect5:2.
prompts.ui: ONE transparent 4-column x2-row UI ICON atlas for a tiny classic Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup roguelike. Exactly8 square cells, no labels or lettering. Each icon must be readable at8x8 to12x12 pixels: extremely coarse 8-bit pixel art, big square clusters, thick dark outline, 4-6 flat solid colors each, NO rendered detail, no gradient, no smooth glow. Centered isolated icons, transparent margins, no frames/background panels. Row1 left to right: 1 gold FIVE-POINT STAR wearing tiny purple crown (ultimate power active); 2 cyan-and-silver SHIELD with one bright central pixel; 3 yellow CLOCK face with black hand and one triangular warning notch; 4 RED warning diamond containing a white cross, aggressive four corner spikes (urgent). Row2 left to right: 5 purple cracked curse skull with red eyes (active wrath); 6 grey/sand HOURGLASS (cooldown); 7 small bright turquoise resource orb cupped in dark-blue bowl; 8 green three-ray SPARK with white core (ordinary power active). Minimal clean tiny video game pictograms drawn directly on an8x8 or12x12 logical grid, shown enlarged uniformly. Every icon separate, no text.
prompts.player:
ONE transparent 2-column x1-row base PLAYER BODY sprite atlas for a classic32x32 Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup game, to go UNDER existing armour, helmet, boots, weapon and shield overlays. Two small standing HUMAN adventurer bases, same dimensions and joint alignment. LEFT short-haired masculine-neutral human, RIGHT short-haired feminine-neutral human. Very coarse low-resolution old PC pixel art: hard square pixel clusters, thick stepped dark outline, 8-10 flat colors, two shades maximum per material, NO gradients, no painterly tiny detail, no glow.
Each logical cell32x32: full figure about14 logical pixels wide and29 high, centered horizontally; head from y3 to10; shoulders at y12; hips at y21; feet at y30. Head width7pixels maximum. Standard standing paper-doll pose with arms slightly angled out to sides, hands low at hip level, legs a little apart. Skin tone light warm beige, dark brown short simple hair, two tiny eye pixels, plain grey sleeveless undershirt, dark charcoal trousers, simple brown shoes. No hat, hood, cape, weapon, shield, jewellery, halo, carried objects or background. These are modestly clothed neutral anatomical bases compatible with separate equipment sprites, NOT elaborate character portraits. Neither base holds any equipment. Same skin/hair palette, distinguish only subtle face/hair shapes. Large empty transparent space on both sides; no cell overlap, no text. Make the native body readable and charming at32x32, not HD pixel art. Atlas aspect2:1, equally sized square cells.
